content: Tailwind CSS 4.3.3 is current stable. Breaking changes from v3: CSS-first config via @theme block instead of tailwind.config.js; @import 'tailwindcss' replaces @tailwind directives; PostCSS still required via @tailwindcss/postcss package; utility renames (shadow-sm->shadow-xs, ring->ring-3, etc); important modifier now postfix (flex! not !flex); requires Safari 16.4+, Chrome 111+, Firefox 128+. Next.js integration: install tailwindcss @tailwindcss/postcss postcss; configure postcss.config.mjs; import in globals.css.
